exposure: Metabolic control in gestational diabetes pregnancies
metabolic control in gestational diabetes pregnancies
cohort: 106 women with gestational diabetes and twin pregnancy and 166 twin controls who delivered viable fetuses > 24 weeks
finding: Gestational diabetes mellitus did not increase the risk of macrosomia or weight discrepancy in twin newborns, and glycemic control did not influence the rate of any of the weight outcomes.
mod_finding: Gestational diabetes did not increase the risk of macrosomia or weight discrepancy of twin newborns, regardless of mode of delivery.
